releases.name: landstrip 0.22.0
releases.body:
Landstrip 0.22.0

landstrip:
- landstrip-api: Ignore query stanzas in blocked-path extraction (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: Switch trap codecs and callers to key=value stanzas (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Cache KVM query decisions and report denied queries (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- trap: Keep --trap events off child stderr (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- trap: Replace JSON records with key=value stanzas (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: Sync POLICY_GLOB_TOO_LONG and POLICY_SELECTOR_LIMIT (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Avoid blocking KVM cancellation on thread exit (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Ignore closed KVM cancellation reply sockets (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Resolve KVM guest fd aliases when opening paths (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Recover guest fds displaced by KVM allocation (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Narrow KVM vCPU descriptor reservation (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

opencode-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.22.0 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- opencode: Isolate --trap stanzas from shell output and query replies (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: Switch trap codecs and callers to key=value stanzas (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: Sync POLICY_GLOB_TOO_LONG and POLICY_SELECTOR_LIMIT (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

pi-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.22.0 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- pi-landstrip: Use stderr traps on Windows and drop query denials (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: Ignore query stanzas in blocked-path extraction (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip-api: Switch trap codecs and callers to key=value stanzas (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

Signed-off-by: Jarkko Sakkinen <jarkko.sakkinen@iki.fi>

releases.name: landstrip 0.21.0
releases.body:
Landstrip 0.21.0

landstrip:
- package: Build static Linux musl brokers via cargo-zigbuild (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Support musl msghdr and cmsghdr layouts in KVM broker (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- tests: Align filesystem selftest oracle with macOS Seatbelt (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- tests: Fix Unix socket selftest paths and bind rule on macOS (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- tests: Avoid Linux-only MSG_TRUNC input flag in recvmsg probe (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- tests: Cover Unix datagram policy under KVM (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Replace Landlock and seccomp with a KVM syscall broker (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- tests: Replace the data harness with landstrip selftest (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Parse proc status IDs without decoding task names (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: Report the sandbox platform instead of the backend (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- trap: Describe records as text on a terminal (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Isolate sandbox sessions from the launcher (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- config: Keep the executable path as named on Unix (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- landstrip: Treat a path below a regular file as unreachable (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

opencode-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.21.0 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- opencode: Bump solid-js to satisfy @opentui/solid peer range (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- build(deps-dev): bump @opencode/theme in /packages/opencode-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps): bump @opentui/core in /packages/opencode-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps): bump @opentui/solid in /packages/opencode-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps-dev): bump oxfmt in /packages/opencode-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps): bump solid-js in /packages/opencode-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- opencode: Keep background shells sandboxed until exit (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- linux: Replace Landlock and seccomp with a KVM syscall broker (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

pi-landstrip:
- Bump the version to 0.21.0 (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- build(deps-dev): bump oxlint in /packages/pi-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps-dev): bump typebox in /packages/pi-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps-dev): bump oxfmt in /packages/pi-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- build(deps): bump minimatch in /packages/pi-landstrip (dependabot[bot])
- linux: Replace Landlock and seccomp with a KVM syscall broker (Jarkko Sakkinen)
- release: update npm package integrity metadata (Jarkko Sakkinen)

Signed-off-by: Jarkko Sakkinen <jarkko.sakkinen@iki.fi>
